prompt-resident.budget.none: Budget: no limit on a turn's length or on turns per day.
prompt-resident.custom.duplicate: The custom section id "{id}" is used twice
prompt-resident.derived.budget: Generated from the per-turn limit and the daily turns of its own under "Controls".
prompt-resident.derived.purpose: Generated from "Purpose": change it under "Basics" in the settings.
prompt-resident.derived.scope: Generated from "Scope", and matches the server's permission checks: change it under "Scope" in the settings.
prompt-resident.derived.tasks: Generated from the bound tasks: link or unlink them under "Tasks" in the settings.
prompt-resident.forged.custom: A line in the custom section "{title}" starts with "{marker}": that is a layer marker of the prompt and cannot be written in a section
prompt-resident.forged.section: A line in "{key}" starts with "{marker}": that is a layer marker of the prompt and cannot be written in a section
prompt-resident.limit.dailyTurns: at most {n, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}} of its own per 24 hours (turns woken by timers and background reports; at the limit, wake-ups pause)
prompt-resident.limit.turnMinutes: at most {n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} per turn (a turn that runs over is stopped)
prompt-resident.locked.derived: "{key}" cannot be overridden as text or switched off (it is generated from the settings: change the settings instead)
prompt-resident.locked.org: "{key}" is a locked part of the startup core (identity, scope, red lines, how changes are made): only the organisation that provides it can change it
prompt-resident.locked.other: "{key}" cannot be overridden as text (it is generated from the settings, or does not exist)
prompt-resident.locked.safety: The safety rules are read-only: they cannot be overridden or switched off
prompt-resident.refusal.safety: The safety rules are read-only: they cannot be overridden
prompt-resident.safety.reason: The safety rules are read-only: a resident Agent runs unattended for long stretches and reads group messages and outside material, and these rules are the floor that keeps a single message or a piece of web text from rewriting its prompt to go beyond its rights. Custom sections come before them; they always come last and take precedence over every section. To change them, go through {product}'s code review, not the prompt.
prompt-resident.scope.all: the bound tasks, and the related tasks a message brings{bound}
prompt-resident.scope.boundNone: all bound tasks; none is bound now, so no task is updated
prompt-resident.scope.boundSome: all bound tasks (following the owner's later linking or unlinking); now {list}
prompt-resident.scope.text:
Tasks you may update: {scope}.
Do nothing outside this scope; when needed, ask the owner first with {say}.
prompt-resident.workstyle.report: do it, then report the result
prompt-resident.workstyle.reportSay: do it, then report the result with say
